## Design

### 2026-11-01: Worked on drawing the schematic on KiCad by creating a new KiCad project, naming it, and placing it with the ZIAO RP2040 RGB LED. I created resistor values for the LEDs' voltage: 270 Ω for red, etc. P

**8h**

Worked on drawing the schematic on KiCad by creating a new KiCad project, naming it, and placing it with the ZIAO RP2040 RGB LED. I created resistor values for the LEDs' voltage: 270 Ω for red, etc. Powered each color through resistors to the LEDs. Was not able to connect them to their pins for the XIO.

Then I fixed every error I had in the ERC, which was really just to add power flags, `PWR_FLAGS`, on the GND and positive 3V3 nets, so that the power goes to where it can. I then assigned footprints, laid out the PCB onto a 3D printer, and the 3D software made a 65 × 35.5 mm two-layer board.
